stem.text: A fairground ride consists of four carriages connected to a central vertical pole, as shown in the following view from above.

stem.alt: Top view of four square carriages on arms joined to a central circle, with labels vertical central pole, carriages, direction of rotation with a curved arrow, and not to scale.

stem.text: A motor rotates the central pole about its axis. This results in the four carriages each moving along a circular path.

The distance from the middle of each carriage to the centre of the pole is $3.20\,\text{m}$. When they are moving, each carriage experiences an air resistance force of $85.0\,\text{N}$. Assume that there are no other significant resistive forces.
Which torque does the motor need to apply to the pole to keep the system rotating at constant maximum speed?
